$comment: Today's faces: what meet_daily_set() returns on the first call of the caller's local day (design §4.2). The set is generated lazily under an advisory lock and is finite: no endless scroll. Paths are object names in the private meet-media bucket, never URLs; the app fetches each through the authenticated object endpoint, so a block applies on the next fetch and nothing shareable exists (design §2.7). M1-PR5 implements it.

prompts.answer: Suya, a long walk and an old Nollywood film
Remembers what I said last week

rendering.distance_band: One of under_5, 5_10, 10_25, 25_50, over_50, with area_label. Never a distance in metres, never a position, never sorted by distance (ADR-0026 D21).
rendering.active: 'today', 'this_week' or null. There is no 'online now' (D20).
rendering.tags: A subset of new_here, popular, verified. 'popular' never comes with a number: there is no leaderboard.
rendering.super_interest_from_them: Tobi sent a super interest; the card says so. A plain like is never shown on a card.
rendering.age: Always present in M1, computed on the server from the birth date set once at check-in. The birth date itself never leaves the server.

end_of_set.note: An empty result once today's set has been acted on: show 'That's today's faces, new ones tomorrow' and count down to the caller's local midnight. A new set is generated on the first call of the next local day.

m2_additions.frame_key: null or a cosmetic frame key
m2_additions.locked: null, or {min_card, ways[]} for a badge-locked profile: see locked-teaser.json
m2_additions.spotlight: true for a boosted profile shown as a spotlight card (at most 2 per viewer per day)

errors_a_client_will_see.ERR_MEET_PROFILE_INCOMPLETE: The caller has no active profile yet (no approved photo). Browsing needs one: show today's question and the ladder until the first photo is approved.
errors_a_client_will_see.ERR_FEATURE_UNAVAILABLE: meet.discovery is off for this caller, or meet.v5 is off or testers-only and the caller is not a tester.
errors_a_client_will_see.ERR_MEET_PROFILE_NOT_FOUND: Opening a card whose person has since blocked the caller, paused, been held or suspended. Indistinguishable on purpose: there is no oracle.
